gates.reason: Inspected the SPA/server boundary, URL/hash construction, clipboard values, and rendering of session-derived data. React interpolation is used without raw HTML injection, session IDs are URL-encoded when written to the hash, and transcript loading is gated by SERVER_AVAILABLE.

Re-derived the local averages, percentages, duration formatting, cost-sort ordering, and top-item scaling; arithmetic is consistent. Scorecard claims expose confidence and evidence, while the session summary is explicitly identified as locally derived.

Inspected the session-list hot path. Derived maps and filtered/sorted collections are memoized, scorecards are lazily cached except when globally required for score sorting, pagination limits list growth, and row windowing avoids rendering detailed off-window row contents.
This test file uses fixed in-memory fixtures and UI events; it implements no authentication, filesystem, network/LLM, command, secret, or unsafe browser-rendering boundary.
This is a component-rendering test and does not implement a detector, parser, recommendation claim, provenance model, validated fix snippet, or production calculation.
This test file does not implement hot-path production code or establish a new production surface requiring a performance probe or budget.
